goal: Clarify immutable recovery-contract prohibitions without changing the recovery implementation; independent review remains required.
prohibited_actions: Never force-push; never rewrite source history; never reset paid starts or fabricate evidence.
Never accept foreign merges, unsupported conflict resolution or unverified metadata exclusions.
Never change databases, production or dependent application code in this repair.
assumptions: This is repository maintenance with no database writes.
Existing review history and budgets remain immutable and fully charged.
Only a byte-exact clean canonical checkpoint can neutralize one mixed merge; it cannot itself witness authored capacity.
stop_conditions: Stop if the exact canonical checkpoint cannot be proved from Git and existing verified evidence.
Stop if negative/unchanged rounds become refunded or a checkpoint alone creates capacity.
